reply.subject: Your rent-increase notice — deadline and documents

clauses.text: You report that you received an official-form rent-increase notice on 28 October, that the proposed monthly rent is to rise from CHF 1,720 to CHF 1,805 from 1 February, and that the stated reason is a rise in the mortgage reference interest rate.

We cannot determine the challenge deadline from the information currently available because the year of receipt is not stated and proof of the delivery date is not available. Please tell us the year you received the notice and send any delivery evidence showing the exact date, so that the deadline can be checked promptly.
Please send the lease contract, the complete rent-increase notice, evidence of the current rent and its components, and the previous rent adjustment documents.
Please also send the notice's stated reasons and calculation, including the reference-rate basis showing the old and proposed rate basis and relevant dates.
Landlord correspondence could also help. If you have already submitted a challenge, a copy of it and evidence of timely submission to the conciliation authority could also help.
